flags.item: Scheduled nfl.com retrieval conflicted with NFL Terms §1.3
flags.detail: NFL Terms §1.3 prohibit 'systematic retrieval of data or other content from the Services, whether to create or compile ... a database', absent express prior written consent. Two workflows still had active cron schedules on main: fl2-lines-snapshot (Wed/Thu/Fri; a scheduled run failed about 6 hours before this check) and fl2-depth-capture (Tuesdays; ran on schedule). The README and availability-snapshot.yml both say capture must stay manual until consent is recorded. Action taken 2026-11-19: this branch paused both cron schedules and the depth push trigger. Session 1541a85c then merged a stricter fail-closed guard to main (job-level `if: vars.FL2_NFL_CAPTURE_AUTHORIZED == 'true'`, which also blocks manual dispatch). This branch keeps main's workflow files unchanged. Owner action needed: obtain written consent or a licensed source before re-enabling.
flags.status: Schedules paused and fail-closed guard on main - owner decision needed (written consent or licensed source) before the variable is set
